title: cicd.yaml
description: Developer-facing pipeline configuration. This is the only file app teams edit to control their CI/CD pipelines - it never contains Tekton, YAML pipeline steps, or infrastructure details. Validated fail-fast by the validate-cicd-config Task before any other pipeline step runs.

agent.description: Named build agent image from the platform catalog. Not a raw image reference - keeps step code portable and centrally patchable.

script.description: Build script the platform runs inside the agent image. Must be bash.

suite.description: Name of the Testkube/test suite to run against the dev deployment.

strategy.description: deployment = native k8s Deployment rollout; rollout = Argo Rollouts (canary/blue-green).

ttl.description: How long an ephemeral environment lives after its last successful deploy before automatic teardown.

governance.description: Quality/security gates. In this phase of the platform these are STUBS - they always report a stub result and are rendered as such in Grafana. Toggling them on prepares your pipeline shape for when real implementations land; it does not enable real enforcement yet.

pipeline.description: Stage graph. Each entry names a stage from the fixed platform stage set and what it runs after. This does not define arbitrary DAGs - it toggles/orders a known, finite set of stages (build, test, deploy, release).

after.description: Name of the stage (optionally suffixed :env, e.g. deploy:staging) this stage runs after. Omit for the first stage.

env.description: Required for deploy/release stages: which environment from deploy.lowerEnvironments/upperEnvironments this instance targets.

approvalRequired.description: Only meaningful on release stages targeting an upper environment.
